If <MATH_0003> is separated then so is <MATH_0004>.
If <MATH_0005> is quasi-separated then so is <MATH_0006>.

Assume that <MATH_0001> is separated.
Consider the factorization <MATH_0002>
of the diagonal morphism of <MATH_0003>.
By Lemma <REF_0001>

of <MATH_0004> in <MATH_0005> is closed. Hence it is also closed
in <MATH_0006>. Thus we see that <MATH_0007>
